label: Customer LTV
shortDescription: Total expected revenue from a customer over their lifetime
formulaSql:
with

orders as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', order_date) as period,
        sum(order_amount) as order_amount,
        count(order_id) as order_count,
        count(distinct customer_id) as customer_count
    from {{ ref('fct_orders') }}
    where status = 'completed'
    group by 1
),

lifespan as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', period_start) as period,
        sum(churned_customer_lifetime_years) as lifetime_years,
        sum(churned_customers) as churned_customers
    from {{ ref('fct_unit_economics') }}
    group by 1
),

periods as (
    select period from orders
    union
    select period from lifespan
)

select
    period,
    order_amount / nullif(order_count, 0)                  -- aov
        * order_count / nullif(customer_count, 0)          -- purchase frequency
        * lifetime_years / nullif(churned_customers, 0)    -- avg lifespan (years)
        as clv
from periods
left join orders using (period)
left join lifespan using (period)
order by period
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: clv
    label: Customer LTV
    description: Total expected revenue from a customer over their lifetime
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: aov * purchase_frequency * avg_lifespan_years
      metrics:
        - name: aov
        - name: purchase_frequency
        - name: avg_lifespan_years
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: clv
        tier: north_star
        vertical: customer
        industry: cross_industry

label: Customer LTV
shortDescription: Predicted or realized revenue from a customer across their lifetime.
formulaSql:
-- Realized LTV: all-time net revenue from completed orders / all-time customers, as of each month.
with completed as (
    select * from {{ ref('fct_orders') }} where status = 'completed'
),
monthly_revenue as (
    select date_trunc('month', order_date) as period, sum(revenue) as revenue
    from completed
    group by 1
),
new_customers as (
    select first_period as period, count(*) as new_customers
    from (
        select customer_id, date_trunc('month', min(order_date)) as first_period
        from completed
        group by 1
    )
    group by 1
),
periods as (
    select period from monthly_revenue
    union
    select period from new_customers
)
select
    p.period,
    sum(coalesce(r.revenue, 0)) over (order by p.period)
        / nullif(sum(coalesce(n.new_customers, 0)) over (order by p.period), 0) as customer_ltv
from periods as p
left join monthly_revenue as r on r.period = p.period
left join new_customers as n on n.period = p.period
order by 1
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: customer_ltv
    label: Realized Customer LTV
    description: Predicted or realized revenue from a customer across their lifetime.
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: lifetime_order_revenue / lifetime_ordering_customers
      metrics:
        - name: lifetime_order_revenue
        - name: lifetime_ordering_customers
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: customer_ltv
        tier: north_star
        vertical: customer
        industry: cross_industry

label: Cost per Outcome
shortDescription: Per-pupil expenditure divided by % of students meeting proficiency — efficiency of investment.
formulaSql:
-- Per-pupil expenditure / state-test proficiency rate, per school and year
-- (fiscal_year and school_year share labels such as '2024-25').
with spend as (
    select
        fiscal_year as school_year,
        school_id,
        sum(total_expenditure) / nullif(sum(avg_daily_membership), 0) as per_pupil_expenditure
    from {{ ref('fct_school_financials') }}
    group by 1, 2
),

proficiency as (
    select
        school_year,
        school_id,
        count(assessment_result_id) filter (where met_standard)
            / nullif(count(assessment_result_id), 0) as student_proficiency
    from {{ ref('fct_assessment_results') }}
    where assessment_type = 'state'
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    s.school_year,
    s.school_id,
    s.per_pupil_expenditure / nullif(p.student_proficiency, 0) as cost_per_outcome
from spend as s
inner join proficiency as p
    on p.school_year = s.school_year
    and p.school_id = s.school_id
order by 1, 2
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: cost_per_outcome
    label: Cost per Outcome
    description: Per-pupil expenditure divided by % of students meeting proficiency — efficiency of investment.
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: per_pupil_expenditure / student_proficiency
      metrics:
        - name: per_pupil_expenditure
        - name: student_proficiency
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: cost_per_outcome
        tier: north_star
        vertical: finance
        industry: cross_industry

label: EBITDA
shortDescription: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation & amortization.
formulaSql:
with

revenue as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', recognized_date) as period,
        sum(recognized_revenue) as revenue
    from {{ ref('fct_revenue') }}
    group by 1
),

cogs as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(cogs_amount) as cogs
    from {{ ref('fct_gl_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

opex as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(opex_amount) as opex
    from {{ ref('fct_gl_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

da as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(depreciation_amount + amortization_amount) as da
    from {{ ref('fct_fixed_asset_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

periods as (
    select period from revenue
    union
    select period from cogs
    union
    select period from opex
    union
    select period from da
)

select
    period,
    revenue - cogs - opex + da as ebitda
from periods
left join revenue using (period)
left join cogs using (period)
left join opex using (period)
left join da using (period)
order by period
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: ebitda
    label: EBITDA
    description: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation & amortization.
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: ebit + da
      metrics:
        - name: ebit
        - name: da
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: ebitda
        tier: north_star
        vertical: finance
        industry: financial_services

label: Enterprise Value
shortDescription: Market cap plus net debt — basis for EV/EBITDA multiples
formulaSql:
with

valuation as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', as_of_date) as period,
        sum(market_cap) as market_cap
    from (
        select *
        from {{ ref('fct_valuations') }}
        qualify as_of_date = max(as_of_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', as_of_date))
    ) as latest
    group by 1
),

balances as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', as_of_date) as period,
        sum(short_term_debt + long_term_debt) as total_debt,
        sum(cash_balance) as cash_and_equivalents
    from (
        select *
        from {{ ref('fct_balance_sheet') }}
        qualify as_of_date = max(as_of_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', as_of_date))
    ) as latest
    group by 1
),

periods as (
    select period from valuation
    union
    select period from balances
)

select
    period,
    market_cap + total_debt - cash_and_equivalents as enterprise_value
from periods
left join valuation using (period)
left join balances using (period)
order by period
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: enterprise_value
    label: Enterprise Value
    description: Market cap plus net debt — basis for EV/EBITDA multiples
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: market_cap + net_debt
      metrics:
        - name: market_cap
        - name: net_debt
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: enterprise_value
        tier: north_star
        vertical: finance
        industry: cross_industry

label: Free Cash Flow

formulaSql:

periods as (

select

    operating_cash_flow - capex as free_cash_flow
from periods
left join ocf using (period)
left join capex using (period)
order by period
formulaYaml:

label: Return on Equity
shortDescription: Net income as a % of shareholders’ equity — profitability from equity capital.
formulaSql:
with

net_income as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', fiscal_period_start) as period,
        sum(net_income) as net_income
    from {{ ref('fct_income_statement') }}
    group by 1
),

balances as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', as_of_date) as period,
        sum(total_assets) - sum(total_liabilities) as shareholder_equity
    from (
        select *
        from {{ ref('fct_balance_sheet') }}
        qualify as_of_date = max(as_of_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', as_of_date))

periods as (
    select period from net_income
    union
    select period from balances

select
    period,

from periods
left join net_income using (period)
left join balances using (period)
order by period

label: Rule of 40
shortDescription: Revenue growth rate + EBITDA margin — benchmark for SaaS health. ≥40 = healthy.
formulaSql:
with

revenue as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', recognized_date) as period,
        sum(recognized_revenue) as revenue
    from {{ ref('fct_revenue') }}
    group by 1
),

cogs as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(cogs_amount) as cogs
    from {{ ref('fct_gl_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

opex as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(opex_amount) as opex
    from {{ ref('fct_gl_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

da as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(depreciation_amount + amortization_amount) as da
    from {{ ref('fct_fixed_asset_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

prior_year as (
    select
        cast(period + interval 1 year as date) as period,
        revenue as prior_year_revenue
    from revenue
),

periods as (
    select period from revenue
    union
    select period from cogs
    union
    select period from opex
    union
    select period from da
    union
    select period from prior_year
)

select
    period,
    (
        (revenue - prior_year_revenue) / nullif(prior_year_revenue, 0)
        + (revenue - cogs - opex + da) / nullif(revenue, 0)
    ) * 100 as rule_of_40
from periods
left join revenue using (period)
left join cogs using (period)
left join opex using (period)
left join da using (period)
left join prior_year using (period)
order by period
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: rule_of_40
    label: Rule of 40
    description: Revenue growth rate + EBITDA margin — benchmark for SaaS health. ≥40 = healthy.
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: (revenue_vs_py + ebitda_margin) * 100
      metrics:
        - name: revenue_vs_py
        - name: ebitda_margin
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: rule_of_40
        tier: north_star
        vertical: finance
        industry: cross_industry

label: Turnover Rate
shortDescription: Percentage of employees who left during the period (voluntary + involuntary)
formulaSql:
-- Separations / average active headcount, per month.
with separations as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', separation_date) as period,
        count(employee_id) as separations
    from {{ ref('fct_separations') }}
    group by 1
),

avg_headcount as (
    -- average active headcount: active employee-days / snapshot days
    select
        date_trunc('month', snapshot_date) as period,
        count(employee_id) filter (where status = 'active')
            / nullif(count(distinct snapshot_date), 0) as avg_headcount
    from {{ ref('fct_employee_snapshots') }}
    group by 1
)

select
    h.period,
    coalesce(s.separations, 0) / nullif(h.avg_headcount, 0) as turnover_rate
from avg_headcount as h
left join separations as s
    on s.period = h.period
order by 1
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: turnover_rate
    label: Turnover Rate
    description: Percentage of employees who left during the period (voluntary + involuntary)
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: separations / avg_headcount
      metrics:
        - name: separations
        - name: avg_headcount
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: turnover_rate
        tier: north_star
        vertical: hr
        industry: cross_industry

label: CAC Payback (mo)
shortDescription: Months to recover customer acquisition cost from gross margin
formulaSql:
with

acquisition as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', period_start) as period,
        sum(total_acquisition_spend) as acquisition_spend,
        sum(new_customers) as new_customers,
        sum(new_customer_mrr) as new_customer_mrr
    from {{ ref('fct_unit_economics') }}
    group by 1
),

revenue as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', recognized_date) as period,
        sum(recognized_revenue) as revenue
    from {{ ref('fct_revenue') }}
    group by 1
),

cogs as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(cogs_amount) as cogs
    from {{ ref('fct_gl_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

periods as (
    select period from acquisition
    union
    select period from revenue
    union
    select period from cogs
)

select
    period,
    (acquisition_spend / nullif(new_customers, 0))
        / nullif(
            new_customer_mrr / nullif(new_customers, 0)
            * (revenue - cogs) / nullif(revenue, 0),
            0
        ) as cac_payback
from periods
left join acquisition using (period)
left join revenue using (period)
left join cogs using (period)
order by period
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: cac_payback
    label: CAC Payback (mo)
    description: Months to recover customer acquisition cost from gross margin
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: cac / nullif(new_customer_mrr / nullif(new_customers, 0) * gross_margin_pct, 0)
      metrics:
        - name: cac
        - name: new_customer_mrr
        - name: new_customers
        - name: gross_margin_pct
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: cac_payback
        tier: kpi
        vertical: customer
        industry: cross_industry

label: LTV : CAC
shortDescription: Ratio of customer lifetime value to acquisition cost — PE efficiency lens.
formulaSql:
with

orders as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', order_date) as period,
        sum(order_amount) as order_amount,
        count(order_id) as order_count,
        count(distinct customer_id) as customer_count
    from {{ ref('fct_orders') }}
    where status = 'completed'
    group by 1
),

lifespan as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', period_start) as period,
        sum(churned_customer_lifetime_years) as lifetime_years,
        sum(churned_customers) as churned_customers
    from {{ ref('fct_unit_economics') }}
    group by 1
),

acquisition as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', period_start) as period,
        sum(total_acquisition_spend) as acquisition_spend,
        sum(new_customers) as new_customers,
        sum(new_customer_mrr) as new_customer_mrr
    from {{ ref('fct_unit_economics') }}
    group by 1
),

periods as (
    select period from orders
    union
    select period from lifespan
    union
    select period from acquisition
)

select
    period,
    (
        order_amount / nullif(order_count, 0)                  -- aov
            * order_count / nullif(customer_count, 0)          -- purchase frequency
            * lifetime_years / nullif(churned_customers, 0)    -- avg lifespan (years)
    )
        / nullif(acquisition_spend / nullif(new_customers, 0), 0) as ltv_cac
from periods
left join orders using (period)
left join lifespan using (period)
left join acquisition using (period)
order by period
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: ltv_cac
    label: 'LTV : CAC'
    description: Ratio of customer lifetime value to acquisition cost — PE efficiency lens.
    type: ratio
    type_params:
      numerator: clv
      denominator: cac
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: ltv_cac
        tier: kpi
        vertical: customer
        industry: cross_industry

label: Product Return %
shortDescription: Percentage of sold units returned by customers
formulaSql:
-- Alias of return_rate.

with returned as (
    select date_trunc('month', return_date) as period, sum(units_returned) as units_returned
    from {{ ref('fct_returns') }}
    group by 1
),
sold as (
    select date_trunc('month', order_date) as period, sum(qty_shipped) as units_sold
    from {{ ref('fct_order_lines') }}
    group by 1
)
select
    coalesce(r.period, s.period) as period,
    r.units_returned / nullif(s.units_sold, 0) as product_return_rate
from returned as r
full outer join sold as s on s.period = r.period
order by 1
formulaYaml:

label: Advanced Course Enrollment
shortDescription: % of students enrolled in AP, IB, or dual-enrollment courses.
formulaSql:
-- Students in at least one AP, IB or dual-enrollment course / active enrollment, per school year.
with advanced as (
    select
        school_year,
        school_id,
        count(distinct student_id) as advanced_course_students
    from {{ ref('fct_course_enrollments') }}
    where course_level in ('ap', 'ib', 'dual_enrollment')
    group by 1, 2
),

enrollment as (
    -- active students on the latest enrollment snapshot of each school year
    select
        school_year,
        school_id,
        count(distinct student_id) as enrollment_count
    from {{ ref('fct_enrollments') }}
    where status = 'active'
        and snapshot_date in (select max(snapshot_date) from {{ ref('fct_enrollments') }} group by school_year)
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    e.school_year,
    e.school_id,
    coalesce(a.advanced_course_students, 0) / nullif(e.enrollment_count, 0) as advanced_course_enrollment_rate
from enrollment as e
left join advanced as a
    on a.school_year = e.school_year
    and a.school_id = e.school_id
order by 1, 2
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: advanced_course_enrollment_rate
    label: Advanced Course Enrollment
    description: '% of students enrolled in AP, IB, or dual-enrollment courses.'
    type: ratio
    type_params:
      numerator:
        name: course_students
        filter: "{{ Dimension('course_enrollment__course_level') }} IN ('ap', 'ib', 'dual_enrollment')"

enrollment as (

label: Student:Teacher Ratio
shortDescription: Number of enrolled students per FTE classroom teacher
formulaSql:
-- Active enrolled students / active teacher FTE, latest snapshots of each month.
with enrollment as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', snapshot_date) as period,
        school_id,
        count(distinct student_id) as enrollment_count
    from {{ ref('fct_enrollments') }}
    where status = 'active'
        and snapshot_date in (select max(snapshot_date) from {{ ref('fct_enrollments') }} group by date_trunc('month', snapshot_date))
    group by 1, 2
),

teachers as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', as_of_date) as period,
        school_id,
        sum(fte) as fte_teachers
    from {{ ref('dim_staff') }}
    where role = 'teacher'
        and status = 'active'
        and as_of_date in (select max(as_of_date) from {{ ref('dim_staff') }} group by date_trunc('month', as_of_date))
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    t.period,
    t.school_id,
    e.enrollment_count / nullif(t.fte_teachers, 0) as student_teacher_ratio
from teachers as t
left join enrollment as e
    on e.period = t.period
    and e.school_id = t.school_id
order by 1, 2
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: student_teacher_ratio
    label: Student:Teacher Ratio
    description: Number of enrolled students per FTE classroom teacher

    type_params:

      denominator: fte_teachers
    config:

        industry: education

label: ARPU
shortDescription: Average Revenue Per User — revenue efficiency across the base.
formulaSql:

    select date_trunc('month', recognized_date) as period, sum(recognized_revenue) as total_revenue

    group by 1
),
customers as (
    select date_trunc('month', order_date) as period, count(distinct customer_id) as ordering_customers
    from {{ ref('fct_orders') }}
    group by 1
)
select
    coalesce(r.period, c.period) as period,
    r.total_revenue / nullif(c.ordering_customers, 0) as arpu
from revenue as r
full outer join customers as c on c.period = r.period
order by 1
formulaYaml:
metrics:

    description: Average Revenue Per User — revenue efficiency across the base.
    type: ratio

        industry: cross_industry

label: Debt / EBITDA
shortDescription: Leverage ratio — total debt divided by trailing twelve-month EBITDA.
formulaSql:
with

revenue as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', recognized_date) as period,
        sum(recognized_revenue) as revenue
    from {{ ref('fct_revenue') }}
    group by 1
),

cogs as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(cogs_amount) as cogs
    from {{ ref('fct_gl_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

opex as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(opex_amount) as opex
    from {{ ref('fct_gl_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

da as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(depreciation_amount + amortization_amount) as da
    from {{ ref('fct_fixed_asset_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

ebitda_monthly as (
    select
        period,
        coalesce(revenue, 0) - coalesce(cogs, 0) - coalesce(opex, 0) + coalesce(da, 0) as ebitda
    from (
        select period from revenue
        union
        select period from cogs
        union
        select period from opex
        union
        select period from da
    ) as periods
    left join revenue using (period)
    left join cogs using (period)
    left join opex using (period)
    left join da using (period)
),

ebitda_ttm as (
    select
        period,
        sum(ebitda) over (order by period range between interval 11 month preceding and current row) as ebitda_ttm
    from ebitda_monthly
),

balances as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', as_of_date) as period,
        sum(short_term_debt + long_term_debt) as total_debt,
        sum(cash_balance) as cash_and_equivalents
    from (
        select *
        from {{ ref('fct_balance_sheet') }}
        qualify as_of_date = max(as_of_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', as_of_date))
    ) as latest
    group by 1
),

periods as (
    select period from ebitda_ttm
    union
    select period from balances
)

select
    period,
    total_debt / nullif(ebitda_ttm, 0) as debt_ebitda
from periods
left join ebitda_ttm using (period)
left join balances using (period)
order by period
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: debt_ebitda
    label: Debt / EBITDA
    description: Leverage ratio — total debt divided by trailing twelve-month EBITDA.
    type: ratio
    type_params:
      numerator: total_debt
      denominator: ebitda_ttm
    config:
      meta:

        tier: kpi
        vertical: finance
        industry: financial_services

label: DPO
shortDescription: Average days taken to pay suppliers
formulaSql:
with

cogs as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(cogs_amount) as cogs
    from {{ ref('fct_gl_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

cogs_ttm as (
    select
        period,
        sum(cogs) over (order by period range between interval 11 month preceding and current row) as cogs_ttm
    from cogs
),

balances as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', as_of_date) as period,
        sum(accounts_payable_balance) as accounts_payable
    from (
        select *
        from {{ ref('fct_balance_sheet') }}
        qualify as_of_date = max(as_of_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', as_of_date))
    ) as latest
    group by 1
),

periods as (
    select period from cogs_ttm
    union
    select period from balances
)

select
    period,
    accounts_payable / nullif(cogs_ttm, 0) * 365 as dpo
from periods
left join cogs_ttm using (period)
left join balances using (period)
order by period

with

label: EV/EBITDA
shortDescription: Enterprise value divided by EBITDA — primary valuation multiple
formulaSql:
with

revenue as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', recognized_date) as period,
        sum(recognized_revenue) as revenue
    from {{ ref('fct_revenue') }}
    group by 1
),

cogs as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(cogs_amount) as cogs
    from {{ ref('fct_gl_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

opex as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(opex_amount) as opex
    from {{ ref('fct_gl_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

da as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(depreciation_amount + amortization_amount) as da
    from {{ ref('fct_fixed_asset_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

ebitda_monthly as (
    select
        period,
        coalesce(revenue, 0) - coalesce(cogs, 0) - coalesce(opex, 0) + coalesce(da, 0) as ebitda
    from (
        select period from revenue
        union
        select period from cogs
        union
        select period from opex
        union
        select period from da
    ) as periods
    left join revenue using (period)
    left join cogs using (period)
    left join opex using (period)
    left join da using (period)
),

ebitda_ttm as (
    select
        period,
        sum(ebitda) over (order by period range between interval 11 month preceding and current row) as ebitda_ttm
    from ebitda_monthly
),

valuation as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', as_of_date) as period,
        sum(market_cap) as market_cap
    from (
        select *
        from {{ ref('fct_valuations') }}
        qualify as_of_date = max(as_of_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', as_of_date))
    ) as latest
    group by 1
),

balances as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', as_of_date) as period,
        sum(short_term_debt + long_term_debt) as total_debt,
        sum(cash_balance) as cash_and_equivalents
    from (
        select *
        from {{ ref('fct_balance_sheet') }}
        qualify as_of_date = max(as_of_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', as_of_date))
    ) as latest
    group by 1
),

periods as (
    select period from ebitda_ttm
    union
    select period from valuation
    union
    select period from balances
)

select
    period,
    (market_cap + total_debt - cash_and_equivalents)
        / nullif(ebitda_ttm, 0) as ev_ebitda
from periods
left join ebitda_ttm using (period)
left join valuation using (period)
left join balances using (period)
order by period
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: ev_ebitda
    label: EV/EBITDA
    description: Enterprise value divided by EBITDA — primary valuation multiple
    type: ratio
    type_params:
      numerator: enterprise_value
      denominator: ebitda_ttm
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: ev_ebitda
        tier: kpi
        vertical: finance
        industry: financial_services

label: Leverage Ratio
shortDescription: Net debt relative to EBITDA — key PE portfolio health metric
formulaSql:
with

revenue as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', recognized_date) as period,
        sum(recognized_revenue) as revenue
    from {{ ref('fct_revenue') }}
    group by 1
),

cogs as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(cogs_amount) as cogs
    from {{ ref('fct_gl_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

opex as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(opex_amount) as opex
    from {{ ref('fct_gl_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

da as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(depreciation_amount + amortization_amount) as da
    from {{ ref('fct_fixed_asset_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

ebitda_monthly as (
    select
        period,
        coalesce(revenue, 0) - coalesce(cogs, 0) - coalesce(opex, 0) + coalesce(da, 0) as ebitda
    from (
        select period from revenue
        union
        select period from cogs
        union
        select period from opex
        union
        select period from da
    ) as periods
    left join revenue using (period)
    left join cogs using (period)
    left join opex using (period)
    left join da using (period)
),

ebitda_ttm as (
    select
        period,
        sum(ebitda) over (order by period range between interval 11 month preceding and current row) as ebitda_ttm
    from ebitda_monthly
),

balances as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', as_of_date) as period,
        sum(short_term_debt + long_term_debt) as total_debt,
        sum(cash_balance) as cash_and_equivalents
    from (
        select *
        from {{ ref('fct_balance_sheet') }}
        qualify as_of_date = max(as_of_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', as_of_date))
    ) as latest
    group by 1
),

periods as (
    select period from ebitda_ttm
    union
    select period from balances
)

select
    period,
    (total_debt - cash_and_equivalents) / nullif(ebitda_ttm, 0) as leverage_ratio
from periods
left join ebitda_ttm using (period)
left join balances using (period)
order by period
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: leverage_ratio
    label: Leverage Ratio
    description: Net debt relative to EBITDA — key PE portfolio health metric
    type: ratio
    type_params:
      numerator: net_debt
      denominator: ebitda_ttm
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: leverage_ratio

        industry: financial_services

label: Magic Number
shortDescription: Net new ARR divided by prior quarter S&M spend — go-to-market efficiency

    on prior.period = net_new.period - interval 3 month

label: CAC Payback Period
shortDescription: Months to recover CAC from gross margin contribution — capital efficiency lens.
formulaSql:
with

acquisition as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', period_start) as period,
        sum(total_acquisition_spend) as acquisition_spend,
        sum(new_customers) as new_customers,
        sum(new_customer_mrr) as new_customer_mrr
    from {{ ref('fct_unit_economics') }}
    group by 1
),

revenue as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', recognized_date) as period,
        sum(recognized_revenue) as revenue
    from {{ ref('fct_revenue') }}
    group by 1
),

cogs as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period,
        sum(cogs_amount) as cogs
    from {{ ref('fct_gl_entries') }}
    group by 1
),

periods as (
    select period from acquisition
    union
    select period from revenue
    union
    select period from cogs
)

select
    period,
    (acquisition_spend / nullif(new_customers, 0))
        / nullif(
            new_customer_mrr / nullif(new_customers, 0)
            * (revenue - cogs) / nullif(revenue, 0),
            0
        ) as payback_period
from periods
left join acquisition using (period)
left join revenue using (period)
left join cogs using (period)
order by period
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: payback_period
    label: CAC Payback Period
    description: Months to recover CAC from gross margin contribution — capital efficiency lens.
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: cac_payback
      metrics:
        - name: cac_payback
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: payback_period
        tier: kpi
        vertical: finance
        industry: cross_industry

        select *
        from {{ ref('fct_income_statement') }}
        qualify fiscal_period_start = max(fiscal_period_start) over (partition by date_trunc('month', fiscal_period_start))
    ) as latest
    group by 1
),

periods as (
    select period from nopat
    union
    select period from capital
)

select
    period,
    nopat / nullif(invested_capital, 0) as roic
from periods
left join nopat using (period)
left join capital using (period)
order by period
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: roic
    label: ROIC
    description: NOPAT divided by invested capital
    type: ratio
    type_params:

      denominator: invested_capital

        tier: kpi
        vertical: finance
        industry: financial_services

label: Runway (Months)
shortDescription: How many months of runway at current burn rate — survival horizon metric.
formulaSql:
with

balances as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', as_of_date) as period,
        sum(cash_balance) as cash_and_equivalents
    from (
        select *
        from {{ ref('fct_balance_sheet') }}
        qualify as_of_date = max(as_of_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', as_of_date))
    ) as latest
    group by 1
),

burn as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', period_start) as period,
        sum(beginning_cash - ending_cash) as burn_rate
    from {{ ref('fct_cash_flow') }}
    group by 1
),

periods as (
    select period from balances
    union
    select period from burn
)

select
    period,
    cash_and_equivalents / nullif(burn_rate, 0) as runway_months
from periods
left join balances using (period)
left join burn using (period)
order by period
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: runway_months
    label: Runway (Months)
    description: How many months of runway at current burn rate — survival horizon metric.
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: cash_and_equivalents / nullif(burn_rate, 0)
      metrics:
        - name: cash_and_equivalents
        - name: burn_rate
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: runway_months
        tier: kpi
        vertical: finance
        industry: cross_industry

label: Suspension Rate
shortDescription: % of students who received at least one out-of-school suspension in a year.
formulaSql:
-- Distinct students with at least one out-of-school suspension / active enrollment, per school year.
with disciplined as (
    select
        school_year,
        school_id,
        count(distinct student_id) as disciplined_students
    from {{ ref('fct_discipline_incidents') }}
    where consequence = 'out_of_school_suspension'
    group by 1, 2
),

enrollment as (
    -- active students on the latest enrollment snapshot of each school year
    select
        school_year,
        school_id,
        count(distinct student_id) as enrollment_count
    from {{ ref('fct_enrollments') }}
    where status = 'active'
        and snapshot_date in (select max(snapshot_date) from {{ ref('fct_enrollments') }} group by school_year)
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    e.school_year,
    e.school_id,
    coalesce(d.disciplined_students, 0) / nullif(e.enrollment_count, 0) as suspension_rate
from enrollment as e
left join disciplined as d
    on d.school_year = e.school_year
    and d.school_id = e.school_id
order by 1, 2
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: suspension_rate
    label: Suspension Rate
    description: '% of students who received at least one out-of-school suspension in a year.'
    type: ratio
    type_params:
      numerator:
        name: disciplined_students
        filter: "{{ Dimension('discipline_incident__consequence') }} = 'out_of_school_suspension'"
      denominator: enrollment_count
    config:

        metricId: suspension_rate
        tier: kpi
        vertical: finance
        industry: cross_industry

label: Training Hours / Employee
shortDescription: Average learning and development hours per employee per period.
formulaSql:

with training as (
    select

        sum(training_hours) as total_training_hours
    from {{ ref('fct_training_records') }}
    group by 1
),

fte as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', snapshot_date) as period,
        sum(fte_fraction) filter (where status = 'active')
            / nullif(count(distinct snapshot_date), 0) as avg_fte
    from {{ ref('fct_employee_snapshots') }}

)

select
    f.period,
    coalesce(t.total_training_hours, 0) / nullif(f.avg_fte, 0) as training_hours_per_employee
from fte as f
left join training as t
    on t.period = f.period
order by 1

label: Employee Attrition Rate
shortDescription: % of workforce that voluntarily left during the period.
formulaSql:
-- Alias of voluntary_turnover. Voluntary separations / average active headcount, per month.
with separations as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', separation_date) as period,
        count(employee_id) filter (where separation_type = 'voluntary') as voluntary_separations
    from {{ ref('fct_separations') }}
    group by 1
),

avg_headcount as (
    -- average active headcount: active employee-days / snapshot days
    select
        date_trunc('month', snapshot_date) as period,
        count(employee_id) filter (where status = 'active')
            / nullif(count(distinct snapshot_date), 0) as avg_headcount
    from {{ ref('fct_employee_snapshots') }}
    group by 1
)

select
    h.period,
    coalesce(s.voluntary_separations, 0) / nullif(h.avg_headcount, 0) as employee_attrition_rate
from avg_headcount as h
left join separations as s
    on s.period = h.period
order by 1
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: employee_attrition_rate
    label: Employee Attrition Rate
    description: '% of workforce that voluntarily left during the period.'
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: voluntary_turnover
      metrics:
        - name: voluntary_turnover
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: employee_attrition_rate
        tier: kpi
        vertical: hr
        industry: cross_industry

label: HC vs Budget
shortDescription: Actual headcount relative to approved headcount budget
formulaSql:
-- Headcount (active full-time, latest snapshot) minus budgeted headcount (latest plan period), per month.
with actual as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', snapshot_date) as period,
        count(employee_id) as headcount
    from {{ ref('fct_employee_snapshots') }}
    where status = 'active'
        and employment_type = 'full_time'
        and snapshot_date in (select max(snapshot_date) from {{ ref('fct_employee_snapshots') }} group by date_trunc('month', snapshot_date))
    group by 1
),

budget as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', period_start) as period,
        sum(budgeted_headcount) as budgeted_headcount
    from {{ ref('fct_headcount_plan') }}
    where period_start in (select max(period_start) from {{ ref('fct_headcount_plan') }} group by date_trunc('month', period_start))
    group by 1
)

select
    b.period,
    coalesce(a.headcount, 0) - b.budgeted_headcount as headcount_vs_budget
from budget as b
left join actual as a
    on a.period = b.period
order by 1
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: headcount_vs_budget
    label: HC vs Budget
    description: Actual headcount relative to approved headcount budget
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: headcount - budgeted_headcount
      metrics:
        - name: headcount
        - name: budgeted_headcount
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: headcount_vs_budget
        tier: kpi
        vertical: hr
        industry: cross_industry

label: Inventory Turnover
shortDescription: COGS divided by average inventory — how many times inventory was sold and replaced
formulaSql:
with cogs as (
    select date_trunc('month', posted_date) as period, sum(cogs_amount) as cogs
    from {{ ref('fct_gl_entries') }}
    group by 1
),
inventory as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', snapshot_date) as period,
        sum(units_on_hand * unit_cost) as inventory_value
    from (
        select
            *,
            max(snapshot_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', snapshot_date)) as month_end_date
        from {{ ref('fct_inventory_snapshots') }}
    )
    where snapshot_date = month_end_date
    group by 1
),
inventory_with_opening as (
    -- beginning inventory = prior month's closing inventory (offset_window: 1 month)
    select
        i.period,
        i.inventory_value,
        p.inventory_value as beginning_inventory_value
    from inventory as i
    left join inventory as p
        on p.period = i.period - interval 1 month
)
select
    i.period,
    c.cogs / nullif((i.inventory_value + i.beginning_inventory_value) / 2, 0) as inventory_turnover
from inventory_with_opening as i
left join cogs as c on c.period = i.period
order by 1
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: inventory_turnover
    label: Inventory Turnover
    description: COGS divided by average inventory — how many times inventory was sold and replaced
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: cogs / ((inventory_value + beginning_inventory_value) / 2)
      metrics:
        - name: cogs
        - name: inventory_value
        - name: inventory_value
          offset_window: 1 month
          alias: beginning_inventory_value
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: inventory_turnover
        tier: kpi
        vertical: hr
        industry: cross_industry

label: Bad Debt Rate
shortDescription: % of revenue written off as uncollectible bad debt.
formulaSql:
with

bad_debt as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', fiscal_period_start) as period,
        sum(bad_debt_writeoffs) as bad_debt_writeoffs
    from {{ ref('fct_income_statement') }}
    group by 1
),

revenue as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', recognized_date) as period,
        sum(recognized_revenue) as revenue
    from {{ ref('fct_revenue') }}
    group by 1
),

periods as (
    select period from bad_debt
    union
    select period from revenue
)

select
    period,
    bad_debt_writeoffs / nullif(revenue, 0) as bad_debt_rate
from periods
left join bad_debt using (period)
left join revenue using (period)
order by period
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: bad_debt_rate
    label: Bad Debt Rate
    description: '% of revenue written off as uncollectible bad debt.'
    type: ratio
    type_params:
      numerator: bad_debt_writeoffs
      denominator: revenue
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: bad_debt_rate
        tier: kpi
        vertical: marketing
        industry: cross_industry

label: Cost per MQL
shortDescription: Total marketing spend divided by MQLs generated.
formulaSql:
-- Monthly marketing spend / leads reaching MQL in the month (fct_leads is owned by the sales domain).
with spend as (
    select date_trunc('month', ad_date) as period, channel, sum(spend) as marketing_spend
    from {{ ref('fct_ad_performance') }}
    group by 1, 2
),
leads as (
    select date_trunc('month', mql_date) as period, channel, count(lead_id) as qualified_leads
    from {{ ref('fct_leads') }}
    where mql_date is not null
    group by 1, 2
)
select
    spend.period,
    spend.channel,
    spend.marketing_spend / nullif(leads.qualified_leads, 0) as cost_per_mql
from spend
left join leads
    on leads.period = spend.period
    and leads.channel = spend.channel

label: Social Engagement %
shortDescription: Average engagements (likes, comments, shares) per post divided by reach
formulaSql:
-- Engagements in the month / followers on the last day of the month.
with monthly as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', metric_date) as period,
        platform,
        sum(total_engagements) as engagements,
        max(metric_date) as last_date
    from {{ ref('fct_social_metrics') }}
    group by 1, 2
),
followers as (
    select s.platform, s.metric_date, sum(s.followers) as followers
    from {{ ref('fct_social_metrics') }} as s
    group by 1, 2
)
select
    monthly.period,
    monthly.platform,
    monthly.engagements / nullif(followers.followers, 0) as social_engagement_rate
from monthly
left join followers
    on followers.platform = monthly.platform
    and followers.metric_date = monthly.last_date

label: Seat Fill Rate
shortDescription: % of available enrollment seats filled by students at a school.
formulaSql:
-- Active enrolled students / available seats, latest snapshots of each month.
with enrollment as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', snapshot_date) as period,
        school_id,
        count(distinct student_id) as enrollment_count
    from {{ ref('fct_enrollments') }}
    where status = 'active'
        and snapshot_date in (select max(snapshot_date) from {{ ref('fct_enrollments') }} group by date_trunc('month', snapshot_date))
    group by 1, 2
),

seats as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', period_start) as period,
        school_id,
        sum(total_seats) as total_seats
    from {{ ref('fct_school_periods') }}
    where period_start in (select max(period_start) from {{ ref('fct_school_periods') }} group by date_trunc('month', period_start))
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    s.period,
    s.school_id,
    coalesce(e.enrollment_count, 0) / nullif(s.total_seats, 0) as seat_fill_rate
from seats as s
left join enrollment as e
    on e.period = s.period
    and e.school_id = s.school_id
order by 1, 2
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: seat_fill_rate
    label: Seat Fill Rate
    description: '% of available enrollment seats filled by students at a school.'
    type: ratio

      denominator: total_seats
    config:

label: GRR
shortDescription: Retained ARR from existing customers excluding expansions
formulaSql:
with snapshots as (
    select
        *,
        max(snapshot_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', snapshot_date)) as last_snapshot_date
    from {{ ref('fct_subscriptions') }}
),

ending_arr as (
    -- ARR on the last snapshot of each month
    select
        date_trunc('month', snapshot_date) as period,
        sum(monthly_amount * 12) as ending_arr
    from snapshots
    where snapshot_date = last_snapshot_date
      and status = 'active'
    group by 1
),

movements as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', movement_date) as period,
        sum(arr_delta) as net_new_arr,
        sum(case when movement_type = 'new_business' then arr_delta else 0 end) as new_arr,
        sum(case when movement_type = 'expansion' then arr_delta else 0 end) as expansion_arr,
        sum(case when movement_type = 'contraction' then -arr_delta else 0 end) as contraction_arr,
        sum(case when movement_type = 'churn' then -arr_delta else 0 end) as churned_arr
    from {{ ref('fct_arr_movements') }}
    group by 1
),

waterfall as (
    -- starting ARR = ending ARR - net movements in the month
    select
        e.period,
        e.ending_arr - coalesce(m.net_new_arr, 0) as starting_arr,
        coalesce(m.expansion_arr, 0) as expansion_arr,
        coalesce(m.contraction_arr, 0) as contraction_arr,
        coalesce(m.churned_arr, 0) as churned_arr
    from ending_arr as e
    left join movements as m using (period)
)

select
    period,
    (starting_arr - churned_arr - contraction_arr) / nullif(starting_arr, 0) as grr
from waterfall
order by period
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: grr
    label: GRR
    description: Retained ARR from existing customers excluding expansions
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: (starting_arr - churned_arr - contraction_arr) / nullif(starting_arr, 0)
      metrics:
        - name: starting_arr
        - name: churned_arr
        - name: contraction_arr
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: grr
        tier: kpi
        vertical: pe
        industry: saas

label: Market Penetration Rate
shortDescription: ARR as a % of Total Addressable Market — how much of the opportunity is captured.
formulaSql:
with

arr as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', snapshot_date) as period,
        sum(monthly_amount * 12) as arr
    from (
        select *
        from {{ ref('fct_subscriptions') }}
        where status = 'active'
        qualify snapshot_date = max(snapshot_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', snapshot_date))
    ) as latest
    group by 1
),

market as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', as_of_date) as period,
        sum(tam_estimate) as tam
    from (
        select *
        from {{ ref('fct_market_sizing') }}
        qualify as_of_date = max(as_of_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', as_of_date))
    ) as latest
    group by 1
),

periods as (
    select period from arr
    union
    select period from market
)

select
    period,
    arr / nullif(tam, 0) as market_penetration_rate
from periods
left join arr using (period)
left join market using (period)
order by period

label: MRR Churn %
shortDescription: Percentage of MRR lost in the period from cancellations
formulaSql:
with snapshots as (
    select
        *,
        max(snapshot_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', snapshot_date)) as last_snapshot_date
    from {{ ref('fct_subscriptions') }}
),

ending_arr as (
    -- ARR on the last snapshot of each month
    select
        date_trunc('month', snapshot_date) as period,
        sum(monthly_amount * 12) as ending_arr
    from snapshots
    where snapshot_date = last_snapshot_date
      and status = 'active'
    group by 1
),

movements as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', movement_date) as period,
        sum(arr_delta) as net_new_arr,
        sum(case when movement_type = 'new_business' then arr_delta else 0 end) as new_arr,
        sum(case when movement_type = 'expansion' then arr_delta else 0 end) as expansion_arr,
        sum(case when movement_type = 'contraction' then -arr_delta else 0 end) as contraction_arr,
        sum(case when movement_type = 'churn' then -arr_delta else 0 end) as churned_arr
    from {{ ref('fct_arr_movements') }}
    group by 1
),

waterfall as (
    -- starting ARR = ending ARR - net movements in the month
    select
        e.period,
        e.ending_arr - coalesce(m.net_new_arr, 0) as starting_arr,
        coalesce(m.expansion_arr, 0) as expansion_arr,
        coalesce(m.contraction_arr, 0) as contraction_arr,
        coalesce(m.churned_arr, 0) as churned_arr
    from ending_arr as e
    left join movements as m using (period)
)

select
    period,
    churned_arr / nullif(starting_arr, 0) as mrr_churn_rate
from waterfall
order by period
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: mrr_churn_rate
    label: MRR Churn %
    description: Percentage of MRR lost in the period from cancellations
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: churned_arr / nullif(starting_arr, 0)
      metrics:
        - name: churned_arr
        - name: starting_arr
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: mrr_churn_rate
        tier: kpi
        vertical: pe
        industry: saas

label: Revenue Growth Rate
shortDescription: YoY or QoQ revenue growth percentage.
formulaSql:
with

revenue as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', recognized_date) as period,
        sum(recognized_revenue) as revenue
    from {{ ref('fct_revenue') }}
    group by 1
),

prior_period as (
    select
        cast(period + interval 1 month as date) as period,
        revenue as revenue_prior_period
    from revenue
),

periods as (
    select period from revenue
    union
    select period from prior_period
)

select
    period,
    (revenue - revenue_prior_period)
        / nullif(revenue_prior_period, 0) as revenue_growth_rate
from periods
left join revenue using (period)
left join prior_period using (period)
order by period

      metrics:
        - name: revenue
        - name: revenue
          offset_window: 1 month
          alias: revenue_prior_period
    config:

        metricId: revenue_growth_rate
        tier: kpi
        vertical: pe
        industry: saas

label: Gross $ Retention
shortDescription: Beginning ARR minus churn and contraction, before expansions
formulaSql:
with snapshots as (
    select
        *,
        max(snapshot_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', snapshot_date)) as last_snapshot_date
    from {{ ref('fct_subscriptions') }}
),

ending_arr as (
    -- ARR on the last snapshot of each month
    select
        date_trunc('month', snapshot_date) as period,
        sum(monthly_amount * 12) as ending_arr
    from snapshots
    where snapshot_date = last_snapshot_date
      and status = 'active'
    group by 1
),

movements as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', movement_date) as period,
        sum(arr_delta) as net_new_arr,
        sum(case when movement_type = 'new_business' then arr_delta else 0 end) as new_arr,
        sum(case when movement_type = 'expansion' then arr_delta else 0 end) as expansion_arr,
        sum(case when movement_type = 'contraction' then -arr_delta else 0 end) as contraction_arr,
        sum(case when movement_type = 'churn' then -arr_delta else 0 end) as churned_arr
    from {{ ref('fct_arr_movements') }}
    group by 1
),

waterfall as (
    -- starting ARR = ending ARR - net movements in the month
    select
        e.period,
        e.ending_arr - coalesce(m.net_new_arr, 0) as starting_arr,
        coalesce(m.expansion_arr, 0) as expansion_arr,
        coalesce(m.contraction_arr, 0) as contraction_arr,
        coalesce(m.churned_arr, 0) as churned_arr
    from ending_arr as e
    left join movements as m using (period)
)

select
    period,
    (starting_arr - churned_arr - contraction_arr) / nullif(starting_arr, 0) as gross_dollar_retention
from waterfall
order by period
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: gross_dollar_retention
    label: Gross $ Retention
    description: Beginning ARR minus churn and contraction, before expansions
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: grr
      metrics:
        - name: grr
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: gross_dollar_retention
        tier: kpi
        vertical: product
        industry: cross_industry

label: Shrinkage Rate
shortDescription: Inventory lost to theft, damage, or administrative error as a percentage of stock
formulaSql:
with shrinkage as (
    select date_trunc('month', snapshot_date) as period, sum(inventory_shrinkage) as inventory_shrinkage
    from {{ ref('fct_inventory_snapshots') }}
    group by 1
),
inventory as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', snapshot_date) as period,
        sum(units_on_hand * unit_cost) as inventory_value
    from (
        select
            *,
            max(snapshot_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', snapshot_date)) as month_end_date
        from {{ ref('fct_inventory_snapshots') }}
    )
    where snapshot_date = month_end_date
    group by 1
),
inventory_with_opening as (
    -- beginning inventory = prior month's closing inventory (offset_window: 1 month)
    select
        i.period,
        i.inventory_value,
        p.inventory_value as beginning_inventory_value
    from inventory as i
    left join inventory as p
        on p.period = i.period - interval 1 month
)
select
    i.period,
    s.inventory_shrinkage / nullif(i.beginning_inventory_value, 0) as shrinkage_rate
from inventory_with_opening as i
left join shrinkage as s on s.period = i.period
order by 1
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: shrinkage_rate
    label: Shrinkage Rate
    description: Inventory lost to theft, damage, or administrative error as a percentage of stock
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: inventory_shrinkage / beginning_inventory_value
      metrics:
        - name: inventory_shrinkage
        - name: inventory_value
          offset_window: 1 month
          alias: beginning_inventory_value
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: shrinkage_rate
        tier: input
        vertical: customer
        industry: retail

label: Expulsion Rate
shortDescription: Percentage of students expelled during the school year
formulaSql:
-- Distinct students with an expulsion / active enrollment, per school year.
with disciplined as (
    select
        school_year,
        school_id,
        count(distinct student_id) as disciplined_students
    from {{ ref('fct_discipline_incidents') }}
    where consequence = 'expulsion'
    group by 1, 2
),

enrollment as (
    -- active students on the latest enrollment snapshot of each school year
    select
        school_year,
        school_id,
        count(distinct student_id) as enrollment_count
    from {{ ref('fct_enrollments') }}
    where status = 'active'
        and snapshot_date in (select max(snapshot_date) from {{ ref('fct_enrollments') }} group by school_year)
    group by 1, 2
)

select
    e.school_year,
    e.school_id,
    coalesce(d.disciplined_students, 0) / nullif(e.enrollment_count, 0) as expulsion_rate
from enrollment as e
left join disciplined as d
    on d.school_year = e.school_year
    and d.school_id = e.school_id
order by 1, 2
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: expulsion_rate
    label: Expulsion Rate
    description: Percentage of students expelled during the school year
    type: ratio
    type_params:
      numerator:
        name: disciplined_students
        filter: "{{ Dimension('discipline_incident__consequence') }} = 'expulsion'"
      denominator: enrollment_count
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: expulsion_rate
        tier: input
        vertical: finance
        industry: cross_industry

order by 1, 2, 3

metrics:

        vertical: finance
        industry: cross_industry

label: OSS Stars
shortDescription: GitHub stars on the company's primary open source repositories
formulaSql:

    select
        *,
        max(as_of_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', as_of_date)) as last_date
    from {{ ref('fct_github_repos') }}
)
select
    date_trunc('month', as_of_date) as period,
    repo,
    sum(star_count) as oss_stars
from latest

metrics:

label: Churn Rate
shortDescription: % of revenue or customers lost in a period.
formulaSql:
with snapshots as (
    select
        *,
        max(snapshot_date) over (partition by date_trunc('month', snapshot_date)) as last_snapshot_date
    from {{ ref('fct_subscriptions') }}
),

ending_arr as (
    -- ARR on the last snapshot of each month
    select
        date_trunc('month', snapshot_date) as period,
        sum(monthly_amount * 12) as ending_arr
    from snapshots
    where snapshot_date = last_snapshot_date
      and status = 'active'
    group by 1
),

movements as (
    select
        date_trunc('month', movement_date) as period,
        sum(arr_delta) as net_new_arr,
        sum(case when movement_type = 'new_business' then arr_delta else 0 end) as new_arr,
        sum(case when movement_type = 'expansion' then arr_delta else 0 end) as expansion_arr,
        sum(case when movement_type = 'contraction' then -arr_delta else 0 end) as contraction_arr,
        sum(case when movement_type = 'churn' then -arr_delta else 0 end) as churned_arr
    from {{ ref('fct_arr_movements') }}
    group by 1
),

waterfall as (
    -- starting ARR = ending ARR - net movements in the month
    select
        e.period,
        e.ending_arr - coalesce(m.net_new_arr, 0) as starting_arr,
        coalesce(m.expansion_arr, 0) as expansion_arr,
        coalesce(m.contraction_arr, 0) as contraction_arr,
        coalesce(m.churned_arr, 0) as churned_arr
    from ending_arr as e
    left join movements as m using (period)
)

select
    period,
    (churned_arr + contraction_arr) / nullif(starting_arr, 0) as churn_rate
from waterfall
order by period
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: churn_rate
    label: Churn Rate
    description: '% of revenue or customers lost in a period.'
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: (churned_arr + contraction_arr) / nullif(starting_arr, 0)
      metrics:
        - name: churned_arr
        - name: contraction_arr
        - name: starting_arr
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: churn_rate
        tier: kpi
        vertical: pe
        industry: saas

    date_trunc('month', recognized_date) as period,
    product_line,
    sum(recognized_revenue) as revenue_by_product
from {{ ref('fct_revenue') }}
group by all
order by all
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: revenue_by_product
    label: Revenue by Product
    description: Revenue broken out by product or service line
    type: derived
    type_params:
      expr: revenue
      metrics:
        - name: revenue
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: revenue_by_product
        tier: input
        vertical: pe
        industry: saas

label: API Calls (Total)
shortDescription: Total API calls made by all integrations and users in the period
formulaSql:
select
    date_trunc('month', request_date) as period,
    endpoint,
    count(request_id) as api_calls_total
from {{ ref('fct_api_requests') }}
group by 1, 2
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: api_calls_total
    label: API Calls (Total)
    description: Total API calls made by all integrations and users in the period
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: request_count
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: api_calls_total
        tier: input
        vertical: product
        industry: cross_industry

label: API Consumers
shortDescription: Distinct applications or users making API calls in the period
formulaSql:
select
    date_trunc('month', request_date) as period,
    count(distinct consumer_id) as api_consumers
from {{ ref('fct_api_requests') }}
group by 1
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: api_consumers
    label: API Consumers
    description: Distinct applications or users making API calls in the period
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: distinct_consumer_count
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: api_consumers
        tier: input
        vertical: product
        industry: cross_industry

label: Sprint Velocity
shortDescription: Average story points completed per two-week sprint
formulaSql:
select
    date_trunc('month', sprint_end_date) as period,
    team,
    avg(story_points_completed) as sprint_velocity
from {{ ref('fct_sprints') }}
group by 1, 2
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: sprint_velocity
    label: Sprint Velocity
    description: Average story points completed per two-week sprint
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: avg_story_points_completed
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: sprint_velocity
        tier: input
        vertical: product
        industry: cross_industry

label: Instructional Minutes
shortDescription: Average minutes of scheduled instruction delivered per student per school day.
formulaSql:
-- Average scheduled instructional minutes per student per school day, per month.
select
    date_trunc('month', attendance_date) as period,
    school_id,
    grade_level,
    avg(instructional_minutes) as instructional_minutes
from {{ ref('fct_student_attendance') }}
group by 1, 2, 3
order by 1, 2, 3
formulaYaml:
metrics:
  - name: instructional_minutes
    label: Instructional Minutes
    description: Average minutes of scheduled instruction delivered per student per school day.
    type: simple
    type_params:
      measure: avg_instructional_minutes
    config:
      meta:
        metricId: instructional_minutes
        tier: input
        vertical: edu
        industry: education
